segments.title: Still copying emails into AI by hand?
segments.say: Still copying your emails and calendar into A I by hand? There's a faster way. It's called a connector.

segments.title: A safe link to your tools
bullets: It only looks when you ask

chat.user: Look at my calendar for next week and list my busiest days. Don't send anything.
chat.ai: (Example answer) Your busiest days are Tuesday and Friday.

segments.say: A connector links Claude to your email, calendar or files, and it only looks when you ask. You'll find it in Settings, under Connectors. What's available depends on your plan.

segments.title: Connect only what you need
bullets: Subscribe for the next quick start
segments.say: Two rules. Connect only what you need, and read the permissions first. You can disconnect any time. Subscribe for the next Claude quick start.
